sections.md: User: *MAKE THE FIRST 30 SECONDS OF THE SCRIPT ONLY.* The nearest clean line to 30s is Paula's **"Energy."** (Scene 1, line 8). Estimated at ~33s. Lines 9–10 and scenes 2–12 are not built.

sections.title: Film Look Sheet
sections.md:
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Genre | Restrained American workplace drama about dignity and age |
| Camera | ARRI Alexa 35, Super 35, Cooke S4/i · 25mm wide, 40mm MCU, 50mm CU, 65mm insert · T2–T4 · 24fps, 180° |
| Light | Overcast daylight through the meeting-room glass (key), hard cool fluorescent top light; 3:1 |
| Palette | Cool greys, off-white, glass and aluminium; charcoal (Paula), navy/ivory (Robin); warm accents only the buff folder and the red VISITOR band |
| Grade (edit only) | Cold, fluorescent for the wound — cool shadows, low saturation |
| Texture | Soft roll-off, no halation, Cooke edge softness; fine grain in the edit |
| Motion | F2 locked; one F1 push on Paula for the verdict |
| Performance | Restrained, still; Paula never plays triumph |
| Sound | Dialogue only in clips; corridor room tone; no music intro, a low cello under the verdict, silence on "Energy." |
